outline.text: New features, improvements, and fixes, most recent first.
Focus time, across your whole calendar
Focus blocks now work everywhere you do. Schedule one in Forma and it appears in your calendar, paus
Set a default focus length and preferred hours in Settings → Focus.
Teammates see “Focusing until 12:00” on your avatar, so they know when you will be back.
End a block early and your notifications catch up in a single summary.
Every automation now keeps a readable history. Open any rule to see each time it ran, what it change
Undo any automated change straight from the log.
Rules that fail explain why and suggest a fix.
Automations run noticeably faster when several fire at once.
Large boards open quicker and scroll smoothly, even with hundreds of cards. Dragging cards between c
Boards load only what is on screen, then fill in the rest.
Card counts in column headers update as you filter.
Team Chat and File Storage integrations
Two of the most requested integrations are here in beta. Turn a team chat message into a task, and a
Link a Teams channel to a project to share updates automatically.
Stored files show a live preview on the task.
Your Monday recap can now arrive in your inbox: what you finished, what is coming up, and anything t
Turn it on or off in Settings → Notifications.
Team plans can send one summary to the whole team.
Fixes for issues reported by customers.
Recurring tasks no longer duplicate when edited across time zones.
Calendar events with long titles now wrap instead of cutting off.
Keyboard focus stays in the command menu after searching.
Save any project as a template and start the next launch, onboarding, or review from a checklist tha
Templates keep tasks, owners by role, due-date offsets, and automations.
A starter library covers roadmaps, briefs, campaigns, and onboarding.
Forma now has a dark theme. Switch between light and dark from the toggle in the header.
Start on the free plan, import a board, and see how much of your week it takes care of.
